why_line: Cooling every cell in liquid so a pack can charge in minutes is a hard electrical and thermal problem, and I'd love to see how your team makes it work.
body:
Hi Clean Electric team,

I'm Pranav, a second-year Electrical Engineering student at IIT Bombay. My winter break runs from the last week of November to the first week of January, and I'd love to spend those six weeks learning at Clean Electric.

A bit about me: I'm on IIT Bombay Racing's driverless team, where I help the car work out where it is on the track, and this semester I've been building digital circuits on an FPGA in our lab.
